messages:
Sam (CSM): Quick heads-up — Arborbank QBR scheduled for next Tue. Need final cost runway + onboarding status by EOD Fri. They're flagged medium risk for renewal: token burn spiked last month. Can we triage?
Meghan (Customer Success): Pulling usage + onboarding notes now. Quick Q — should we include the new embeddings pipeline in the spend calc? They kicked off a retrain batch last week.
Derek (Solutions): Yes include embeddings. Their heavy sources: (1) live chat generator, (2) embeddings for semantic search, (3) a reranker. Embeddings are the biggest surprise if batch size stays low. Suggest enabling async batching + prefix cache for repeated vectors.
Arjun (AE): FYI finance wants a 3-month spend forecast for the renewal deck. Goal is to present a 10–15% cost-reduction runway with recommended ops changes.
Lia (EngOps): I'll run a forecast from the last 90 days and simulate two optimization levers: (A) reduce max_context to 2k for chat + knob down sampling on low-priority prompts, (B) enable prefix KV cache TTL=24h + increase embedding batch size. ETA ~2 hours.
BillingBot: :warning: Alert: Arborbank exceeded monthly forecast by 34% on 2026-11-19. Chargeable overage estimate: $18,400. Details: https://billing.redwood.ai/r/arb-9234
Meghan (Customer Success): Noted. Action items: (1) Lia to run forecast variants and paste numbers here, (2) Derek to produce config snippets and expected token delta per route, (3) Sam/Arjun to draft slide with ask: dedicated vs hosted cost tradeoffs + optional onboarding credit.
Derek (Solutions): Quick config snippet — embedding batch increase + prefix cache policy (low friction):

```yaml
model: text-embedding-002
batch_size: 256
cache:
  policy: prefix
  ttl_seconds: 86400
```

Estimated token delta: embeddings throughput up, tokens per request unchanged but better amortized cost (~-18% embedding token cost).
Lia (EngOps): Forecast numbers pasted below from simulation: 

- Baseline (30d extrap): $54,200/mo
- Opt A (cache + batching): $41,800/mo (approx -23%)
- Opt B (reduce context + quantize + Dedicated commit): $36,900/mo (approx -32%)

Recommendation for QBR: show Opt A as realistic ops play; Opt B as product+proc change requiring Dedicated/commit and infra work.

Sample cost calc I used: 
```
# simplified
tokens_per_month = 1.2e9
price_per_token = 4e-8
cost = tokens_per_month * price_per_token  # = $48,000
```

(Adjusts per-model weights and embeddings multiplier.)
Arjun (AE): Good clarity. For renewal we can propose a 6-month Dedicated commit with a small burst pool to enable Opt B during peak traffic. Suggest offering a 10% onboarding credit if they sign before EOM.
Sam (CSM): Perfect. Final asks before I assemble the deck: Lia — paste the month-by-month CSV of the 3 forecasts and a 3-bullet summary. Derek — produce a 1-pager runbook to enable prefix cache on their account (steps + expected rollback + risk). Meghan/Arjun — I'll draft the renewal language and ask. Target: Friday EOD.
Meghan (Customer Success): I'll gather customer feedback notes and whether they saw any regressions after the retrain job; will include in the deck.
Derek (Solutions): I'll add a small rollback snippet and a CLI command example: `redwood config set --account arb-9234 --cache.prefix_ttl 86400` and a quick healthcheck: `redwood metrics query --account arb-9234 --metric token_rate --window 5m`.
Lia (EngOps): CSV + slides uploaded to the Arborbank folder: https://drive.redwood.ai/arb-9234/qbr-assets. Will also attach the raw forecast JSON.
Sam (CSM): Awesome, thanks team. Let's sync briefly at 10:30 tomorrow to finalize slide order. :thumbsup:
